description: Perigee Tides & Conditions helps people find NOAA tide-prediction stations and check near-term coastal outing windows for fishing, boating, paddling, beachcombing, photography, and coastal-living checks. For a selected station, activity, local date, and time within seven days, it combines available tide predictions, NWS wind forecasts, daylight and moon calculations, and NOAA water observations into a planning state, recommended window, confidence, reasons, cautions, freshness, and provider attribution. Coverage is limited to NOAA CO-OPS U.S. and territory tide-prediction stations, and data availability varies by station. It is a planning aid—not navigation, emergency guidance, a comprehensive weather forecast, route clearance, or a safety verdict.
